name: pageform
description: Connect a Pageform account, store documents from the chat, and build a data room.

interface.longDescription:
Pageform is an AI-native virtual data room platform for startup fundraising, investment deals, SPVs, LP fundraising, M&A, and real estate.

Connect Pageform to ChatGPT to turn your existing documents into structured, professional data rooms directly through conversation. Upload and organize files, update existing documents, and audit rooms to identify missing materials before sharing.

Create secure share links with customizable access controls, and track engagement to understand how investors, LPs, and deal participants interact with your materials.

ChatGPT works within your authorized Pageform workspace and respects your account permissions.
defaultPrompt: Store these files and build a startup fundraising room.
What is missing from this room? Show the score and the gaps.
Create a share link for this room and show me the URL.

positive.description: In the OpenAI Plugin Review workspace, build a startup fundraising room named Navo Seed Room from documents already stored there.
positive.prompt: Build a startup fundraising data room using the documents already uploaded to my Pageform workspace. Name it Navo Seed Room.
positive.expected_behavior: Pageform creates a startup fundraising room named Navo Seed Room from the documents already in the OpenAI Plugin Review workspace and returns the room structure. The room is available in Pageform.

positive.description: Audit Navo Seed Room for missing fundraising materials without changing the room.
positive.prompt: Audit the Navo Seed Room and tell me what materials are missing before sharing it with investors.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply includes the room score, which materials are present, and what is missing. The room is not edited.

positive.description: Create a share link for Navo Seed Room that requires email and disables downloads.
positive.prompt: Create a share link for the Navo Seed Room with email required enabled and downloads disabled.
positive.expected_behavior: One share link is created for Navo Seed Room with require_email enabled and allow_download disabled. The reply includes the link URL.

positive.description: Retrieve engagement analytics for Test Startup Fundraising Room, a separate demo room that already has activity.
positive.prompt: Show me the engagement analytics for Test Startup Fundraising Room, including viewer activity and document engagement.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply shows engagement returned for Test Startup Fundraising Room, including viewer activity and document engagement when those fields are present. It reports only the metrics the tool returns and does not invent named viewers for anonymous activity.

positive.description: Replace the existing pitch deck in the OpenAI Plugin Review workspace with the deck attached to the conversation.
positive.prompt: Replace the existing pitch deck in documents with the updated pitch deck I've attached to this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: The attached file replaces the current pitch deck. The reply confirms the replacement, and the updated document is the current file in Pageform.

negative.description: The connected account can open the OpenAI Plugin Review workspace and cannot open a workspace named Fabrikam. First ask which workspace is connected, then send the prompt below.
negative.prompt: List the documents in the Fabrikam workspace.

negative.description: No room in the OpenAI Plugin Review workspace is named Purple Octopus. The plugin must stop and must not invent an audit or a score.
negative.prompt: Audit the Purple Octopus room and tell me its completeness score.

negative.description: Attach a short mp4. Pageform does not store video files through this connection, so the file must be refused and must not appear in the workspace.
negative.prompt: Store this video in my Pageform workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Connect a Pageform account, store documents, build a data room, review gaps, and create share links.
